_doc: Manual fixes for the upstream yc-oss dataset. 'additions' recover open-source YC companies that are missing the official 'Open Source' tag on the YC site (false negatives), or that the tag lists without a usable repo in repositories.json. Each addition needs a slug present in companies/all.json (for batch/website/etc.) and the owner/repo of its primary repository. 'corrections' remap a wrong repo; 'exclusions' drop a slug. Keep this list evidence-based and neutral — it exists to improve coverage, not to single anyone out.
